signal_summary: The Sep 12 UNI starter thesis gained an independent product-usage confirmation. Uniswap Labs launched StablePair on Ethereum mainnet Sep 10 with USDC/USDT and USDC/USDG; by Sep 15 the USDC/USDT StablePair was reported as Ethereum's highest-volume pool. This product-level adoption arrived while UNI turnover reaccelerated and Uniswap fees/revenue rose. The evidence is actual secondary swap activity rather than RWA issuance/AUM or an airdrop/points/yield-farming campaign.

ecosystem_regime_evidence.stablepair_usage_confirmation: USDC/USDT StablePair reported as highest-volume pool on Ethereum five days after launch
ecosystem_regime_evidence.incentive_classification: No evidence found that the StablePair usage breakout is primarily explained by points, quests, token emissions, trading rewards or rebates. StablePair is a dynamic-fee market-structure product.

leadership_rotation_evidence: UNI was already a qualified cross-chain infrastructure/value-capture candidate. StablePair adds a distinct stablecoin-liquidity product that achieved network-level pool leadership within five days, strengthening Uniswap's venue leadership without relying on the previously discounted Robinhood Chain activity.

wallet_quality_evidence.prior_context: The Sep 12 starter relied partly on a Sep 11 tracked-whale accumulation cohort, but beneficial-owner independence was not proven.
wallet_quality_evidence.treatment: No extra wallet-quality score is awarded today. The confirmation add is based on independent product adoption plus fee/revenue and price/turnover confirmation, not a recycled wallet headline.

value_capture.details: Uniswap's current protocol-fee architecture routes fees from enabled protocol components through Fee Adapters into chain TokenJars; releasers can exchange collected assets for burned UNI. StablePair's dynamic LP fees are not assumed to be the same as protocol fees or automatically burned UNI.

liquidity_executability.reason: UNI has broad CEX/DEX liquidity and roughly $657M of 24h token turnover; Tier A 0.15% simulated one-way execution cost used.

caveats: UNI market-cap/FDV ratio is about 0.70 rather than fully diluted.
StablePair is behind an upgradeable proxy controlled by Uniswap Governance.
OpenZeppelin's review covered the core fee mechanism in a non-upgradeable predecessor; upgradeability and role model postdated that review.
Governance cannot expand immutable hook permission flags to block LP withdrawals or add arbitrary custom-accounting permissions, according to Uniswap's security documentation.
No fresh independent selective-wallet convergence was verified in this run.

why_now: The first UNI paper entry was made after cross-chain protocol acceleration, tracked-whale breadth and initial token-price confirmation. The missing independent confirmation was whether a new Uniswap product could generate organic usage rather than the thesis merely reflecting broad market beta or previously observed flows. StablePair achieving Ethereum pool-volume leadership in five days, alongside rising Uniswap fees/revenue and an 86% day-over-day increase in UNI token turnover, clears that confirmation threshold.

Robinhood Chain: raw activity remains discounted because prior research identified synthetic-volume contamination and launch-token speculation can pollute flow metrics.

major_uncertainties: The highest-volume-pool report is a point-in-time leadership snapshot and needs persistence.
StablePair LP fee generation should not be conflated with UNI protocol-fee burn unless the relevant fee adapter is enabled and fees are actually routed through the protocol-fee system.
No new selective-wallet cohort was independently verified today.
The broader crypto market faces near-term regulatory/macro event risk, so part of UNI price movement can remain beta.
